src: It's the image of us humans still being connected to our community, even after death, right?
Sure.
Your heap isn't very impressive, actually.
What? You can't be serious. It's the biggest and most beautiful heap of corpses in the Crystal City already.
And I know it can become a much more magnificent heap even.
But even if I had to retire right now, if the heap would be left like that, no one taking care of it, even then it would still be a great wonder to be seen.
A monument of art. A symbol representing our sophisticated human nature, a sign for the ages.
It doesn't look like much, really.
I think you're just envious of my heap.
That's disgusting, using dead people.
You don't know if they wanted to be part of some art installation.
Do YOU know if they wanted to be part of an art installation or not?
I don't.
Then it's totally possible that they would be happy about their earthly remains being used for something that's useful to other people?
Don't know if that's really useful.
Of course it is. Feeding the soul is as important as feeding the body.
You can't survive if one of the two is dead. Both of them can starve, if you don't take care of them.
A starving soul, lacking meaning in life, that is one of the worst things that could happen to anyone.
These are dead though.
Uhm, right, I concede that point.
At a minimum though they contribute to providing myself with meaning.
Can I have one of your corpses?
They are not for sale. Sorry. And no sharing either.
Don't touch them!
They're sorted.
What are those?
Corpses. I collect them.
Is Heptarch Hevla one of the bosses of the Collectors?
I won't talk about Heptarch Hevla with you nor about any of the other Heptarchs.
I might have a memory for you.
Alright. What do you have for me?
What are you looking for again?
Memories from all sorts of encounters or experiences that feel special. That are one of a kind.
I witnessed two people caring about each other while influenced by the Urge.
This is a formidable memory. The Seneschal will be very pleased.
I met a queen once who didn't want to have sex with me.
A fine memory which we will duly reward.
Unfortunately it's not enough to be introduced to the Seneschal.
I have the image of an old naked man etched into my brain.
Uhm. That won't be of interest to us.
Damn. Alright.
Please. I need someone I can share this with.
Well. It's a really weird one. A bit gross, even.
Doesn't that make it special?
Uhm. Alright.
I met the Fleshkraken.
I became a friend of the Fleshkraken.
Someone told me you had problems here recently.
There...
There has been a break-in.
But... you don't have to worry about it. We have everything under control here.
Was the break-in caused by some walking Titan-thing?
How do you know about that?
Just a guess.
Can I take a look at the crime scene?
Absolutely not.
And you would have to ask the Seneschal about that anyway.
I would like to see the Seneschal now.
I am sorry. But your person won't be of interest to the Seneschal at the moment.
That might change if you deliver us a very special memory.
Yes, I think that can be arranged.
The Seneschal will find you interesting.
You may visit him now.
Who's the Seneschal?
The Seneschal is a... well, he serves as the master of the Villa as long as the Heptarch is away.
And who's the Heptarch?
It would be inappropriate to talk about Heptarch Hevla.
Hey, there. Do you like experiences?
Experiences? Like what?
Imagine standing on a mountain and hugging a fresh sunrise. Or falling beneath the sea, shrinking to eternity.
Planting new love. Realizing a grave mistake but transforming it into victory. All the moments that make life worth living.
We, the Collectors, preserve these precious moments. We do honest business. Our aim is not only to collect, but also to preserve.
So you wanna share these experiences with everyone?
We do with some, actually, as you can see in these halls. But not with all of them.
Some memories are too dangerous to be shared with the public. And then there are memories that are more precious because they are exclusive.
Sharing them would diminish them.
For us, collecting is an important opportunity to preserve something that's worth keeping.
If you have some interesting memory to offer, I would gladly listen to what that might be.
Now, how can I be of service?
We will accept this memory.
Prepare yourself and slow down.
{A moment of rest.}
Hold still. This won't hurt much.
{A sensation in your bones.}
{Cold fingers reach for your brain and heart.}
{After a while the coldness leaves and your conscience returns.}
{A sensation of fatigue and exhaustion remains.}
Ah. There it is.
We thank you.
What are you working on?
Thoughts beget thoughts. So I'm begetting right now.
Making stuff arrive. Making more of it arrive. At some point there'll be a ton of it.
Yeah, but what's your current project?
Can't say at the moment. Really don't know yet.
Everything feels like bullshit anyway since the muse got stuck.
I think I nudged the Muse.
Really? So what's up with her now?
She's in a friendly place now.
Really? So what does that look like?
Trees. Sunshine. Peaceful and quiet.
What? And THAT makes her happy?
I guess so.
Wow. Cool. Didn't expect that.
Maybe that other stuff in the past was a bit wild. Maybe she needs a bit of rest.
Yeah. I can picture that, kind of. It's weird, it's unexpected. It gives me an idea.
She's in a dreadful place now, but she likes it.
Yes, that sounds like her.
So, is she in danger?
I don't think so. But I am not sure about that.
A bit of uncertainty in life. Like never knowing if there's a sword of Damocles hanging over our heads.
I can see how her anxiety will thrive there.
Good enough for me. Gives me an idea.
She's dead actually.
What the fuck?
I didn't mean that kind of nudging when I told you to nudge her.
It happened.
Well, fuck that.
Action and consequences. I should have known.
I ask someone else to nudge her instead of doing it myself, and of course karma fucks me up.
I guess I'll have to figure out becoming inspired again.
It's better like that.
What? Why?
Uhm, she was holding you back.
Better to find inspiration in lots of different places.
Hmmh. I don't know.
I admit I was pretty pissed sometimes about needing a muse. Maybe I was pissed about her, too.
Yeah, I guess I can look at new things, try some fresh stuff.
Taste? What kind of taste?
I don't know. I need something exquisite, I guess.
What does that even mean?
I think you're looking in the wrong place.
Fuck. I don't have any taste.
You are supposed to take a look at my muse, and maybe give her a nudge.
She's inside that Cyberwomb module I gave you.
There's a projector room here in the market.
What's up with your muse?
It's complicated.
She's stuck over there. I cannot push her. She can't get out. And I don't want to move in.
As I said, it's complicated.
You wanna visit her? See for yourself what's ailing her?
No, I don't think so.
Whatever.
Yeah, I guess I can take a look.
Cool.
Here. Take this.
Maybe you can give her a nudge.
We'll see.
I've seen the world fractured into pieces. Fucking hard to puzzle it all together again.
But work, work never stops, right?
Hahaha.
Fuck this shit.
What's up?
Are you missing some clothes?
I don't, actually.
I execute my free will by walking around as I see fit.
Naked, as nature created me.
You're not fully naked.
What? How dare you say this to me?
Here, look at this.
What sayest thou now? Did you witness the power of my refined naked body?
But you're still having some clothes on.
You're like... half-naked.
I... That is...
{He sighs.}
You're right. You're absolutely right.
It's not the same.
About your half-nakedness...
Yes?
Why aren't you fully naked?
I... I don't have the courage for that yet.
Not like the master. I saw him once, his magnificent aura radiating from a strong, lean body. Age had marked him, but he carried something timeless.
His image stayed in my mind after that, providing me with constant joy.
[Continue listening.]
But I am not as strong as the master.
I hope that someday I'll be able to throw off the last of my shackles and become as free as him.
That image lingers in my mind, too.
You saw the master?
Yes, I met him.
Oh, how wonderful. This makes me happy, knowing that there are more of us, carrying around that image.
Hey.
Hey.
An observer approaches.
Who are you?
We are many. In solitude. A fragment, maybe. Hopefully. Of the Flesh Nexus.
Spawned there. Riding it, becoming part of it, weaving in and out.
This is how I arrived here. Weak and curious. Captured, really. Enamored by the interest.
Reciprocal, of course.
And where are you from?
Remember the Shattering? Born anew. Humans watching us.
The eternal hunger visible in their eyes, again.
Hunger defined them. And now it defines us.
I don't remember the Shattering.
Humans have short lives. They don't remember.
The Feeder was here. Regretful.
I am looking for the Feeder.
He's gone. He nurtured us. With violence. Pain and warmth. Before. Before all of this.
But we grew. We awoke. Wouldn't let him in again.
And we left him. Abandoned.
His rage moving forward. On and on.
You are new here.
I have dedicated some time towards explicating the crux of the situation regarding what I commonly refer to as the Urge.
But my effort had to be constrained, naturally, as the recipients of these explanations lacked basic deduction skills.
Frankly told.
I would be interested in having another try at it. The explaining, that is. If you would be interested in the intertwined metaphorical and biological structures of the Urge.
And I am looking for some practical assistance.
So what is this Urge exactly?
